title: Native Linux build and release qualification alongside Windows
acceptance: Build authenticated Linux sysroot and execute consumer; enforce native TLS dynamic linkage with artifact evidence; preserve Windows gates; run affected Rust tests and clippy. Release only after complete integration and production qualification.

validation.clippy: passed, all xtask targets, warnings denied
validation.native_sysroot_consumer: passed, authenticated custom standard library, Unicode 16.0 ICU 76
validation.elf_boundary: passed on stripped debug candidate with actual LLD map; diagnostic only
validation.thin_lto: actual native rustc executable and link map passed
validation.other_hosts: Windows and aarch64 require native execution; macOS and musl fail closed

architecture.command: pinned rustc --edition 2021 --test with CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR and genuine dependency artifacts

integration_findings: Removed duplicated Unix lint attributes; replaced susi-gawd cross-crate source mount with a std-only Cargo dependency, preserved gate coverage and added CI shard membership.
